acceptance: Fresh caller UUID from dory.pvh_run_id in every result; seven pass results, zero failures, one matching unprefixed runner receipt; shutdown.request is requested only and requires independent host ACPI S5 evidence. No build-only qualification.
limitations: BusyBox/musl only; no glibc, systemd or general-purpose distribution qualification.
Shell process isolation and exec/wait semantics; exact fork/clone/vfork syscall choice is not traced.
64 KiB shell allocation/copy only; no malloc/mmap stress or exhaustion contract.
USR1 handler and sleep/uptime only; no complete signal or timer syscall coverage.
Writable tmpfs only; no block filesystem persistence qualification.

runnerProtocol.workloadsPassed: true only when all seven named checks passed
runnerProtocol.workloads: exact seven expectedResults names except shutdown.request
runnerProtocol.hostCompletion: independent ACPI S5 poweredOff exit required
